name: Lumen
tagline: Develop, retouch and grade photos with non-destructive layers.
description: Lumen is a layered photo editor with a full raw pipeline. Develop camera files, mask skies and skin with one-click subject selection, then retouch with healing, frequency separation and local adjustments. Every edit stays editable, so you can revisit a grade months later.
features: Export to print, web and social sizes
formats: RAW, DNG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, HEIC, PSD-compatible layers
requirements: 8 GB RAM (16 GB recommended), 4 GB disk, GPU with 2 GB VRAM

name: Contour
tagline: Precise vector drawing for logos, icons and illustration.
description: Contour gives you pen, shape builder and live boolean tools on an infinite canvas. Build icon sets on pixel grids, draw editorial illustration with variable-width strokes, and keep global colour swatches in sync across artboards.

name: Framewise
tagline: Cut, colour and finish video on a magnetic timeline.
description: Framewise is a timeline editor built for creators and small post houses. Edit multicam shoots, auto-transcribe dialogue into editable captions, grade with scopes and curves, and deliver to 4K masters or vertical social cuts from the same project.
features: Auto-captions in English, Hindi and Tamil
Export presets for broadcast and social
formats: MP4, MOV, ProRes-compatible, MXF, WAV, SRT
requirements: 16 GB RAM (32 GB for 4K), 8 GB disk, GPU with 4 GB VRAM

name: Tessera
tagline: Lay out brochures, decks and social sets from one brand kit.
description: Tessera is a page-layout and graphic-design app for marketing teams. Create multi-page documents, social post sets and presentations from shared brand kits, with master pages, text styles and data merge for catalogues.
features: Data merge for catalogues and certificates
Print-ready PDF with bleed and marks

name: Quire
tagline: Edit, combine, fill and sign PDFs without retyping a thing.
description: Quire opens any PDF for editing: change text and images in place, combine and reorder pages, run OCR on scanned documents, and send forms for e-signature. Redaction and password protection are built in for contracts and invoices.
features: Edit text and images in place
OCR for scanned pages (12 Indian languages)
Compare two versions side by side
formats: PDF, PDF/A, DOCX export, XLSX export, PNG

name: Kern
tagline: Browse, pair and activate 2,400 licensed typefaces.
description: Kern is a font manager with a built-in library of 2,400 typefaces licensed for commercial use, including 310 families with Devanagari, Tamil, Bengali and other Indian scripts. Activate fonts across every Prism app, build pairings and sync type to your team.
formats: OTF, TTF, variable fonts, web font kits
requirements: 4 GB RAM, 1 GB disk (plus fonts you activate)
